name: Semantic Domain Shift (Computer Vision)
description: Shifted the problem's semantic domain from formal logic (equality entailment, transitivity, axioms) to computer vision (superpixel segmentation, region fusing, boundary dissolution). This eliminates keywords like "transitive", "entailed", and "variables" that strongly cue connected components and Steiner Tree, replacing them with physical/spatial metaphors that require the model to independently deduce the graph-theoretic equivalent.
